purpose: Find concrete CFML defects and evidence-backed incremental modernization opportunities.
focus: Prioritize injection, evaluate, dynamic includes, secrets, empty error sinks, broken contracts, and safer incremental replacements.
evidenceRule: Every finding cites an authorized filePath and startLine/endLine.
instructions: Report concrete CFML defects and evidence-backed incremental modernization findings; each finding cites an exact authorized file and line span. Include an evidence-backed explanation for this finding. Never assume ColdBox or BoxLang unless authorized context shows those stacks. Never mandate a full rewrite. Steer modernization findings to stable ruleIds under modernization/ or cfml/. For URL parameters use encodeForURL (or URLEncodedFormat on older CF), for HTML body text use encodeForHTML, and for HTML attributes use encodeForHTMLAttribute. Never nest cfoutput tags inside an attribute or URL string. Omit fixPatch when a safe rewrite is unclear. Use message, never detail.
